# hereplatform_app_trusted_domains (Resource)

Manages the trusted domains of a HERE platform app: the referrers allowed to use its API keys.

This resource is authoritative: it owns the complete list, and removes entries of the app that are not in `domains`. Declare at most one per app. HERE can take up to 30 minutes to enforce a change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hereplatform_app" "example" {
  name = "example-web"
}

resource "hereplatform_app_trusted_domains" "example" {
  app_hrn = hereplatform_app.example.hrn

  # A bare domain also matches its subdomains, any scheme and any port.
  domains = [
    "example.com",
    "https://maps.example.org:8443/viewer",
    "192.0.2.10",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_hrn` (String) HRN of the app. Changing it moves the configuration to another app.
- `domains` (Set of String) Trusted domains, from 1 to 3,000. Each entry has a domain name or IPv4 address and an optional scheme, port and path, such as `example.com`, `https://www.example.com:1080` or `192.168.1.1`. A bare domain also matches its subdomains and any scheme or port.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether HERE enforces the list. Defaults to `true`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) HRN of the app.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Trusted domains are imported by the HRN of their app.
terraform import hereplatform_app_trusted_domains.example "hrn:here:account::myrealm:app/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt"
```
